crossRefs.note: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even…
Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand…
Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the…
The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day…

translations.web: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
translations.bsb: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
translations.kjv: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
translations.asv: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and they four had their rims full of eyes round about.
